name: Shape Metal
body:
School transmutation [earth]; Level cleric/oracle 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (ore)

EFFECT

Range touch

Target ore or metal object touched, up to 10 cu. ft. + 1 cu. ft./level

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You can form an existing piece of metal into any shape that suits your purpose. While it’s possible to make crude coffers, doors, and so forth with metal shape, fine detail isn’t possible. There is a 30% chance that any shape including moving parts simply doesn’t work.
